title: WanRecord v1 — one fabric message's standing on one WAN-shaped link: the message id and both ends as they stood when judged (null where a malformed message carried nothing usable), the profile that shaped the crossing, the verdict — delivered (it reached the recipient's inbox) or dropped — the named reason for a drop (lost_after_retries: every attempt was lost under the profile; malformed: the message failed the fabric_message contract or named a different recipient than the link's), how many attempts the crossing took, and the total simulated latency in milliseconds including retry backoff (null for a malformed message, which never entered the shape); identifiers and counts only, never payload content (Y-063)
